pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with rounded vertices and smooth edge gradients. Spatial area is largest at the mid-flank and reduces in scale towards the ventral and posterior margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, with relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.
